svg.title: VERDICT: Case lifecycle
svg.text: Every state a case can be in, who moves it, and the only path that ends in a published verdict.
Either side withdrew consent before FINALIZED. No card is
published and the Twitch Prediction is canceled. Anything
already broadcast stays on-chain, never shown as a verdict.
Status rail in the app and the Live Court overlay.
VERDICT, Settle It, Live Court, Developer API
appeal re-enters as a new package: tier + 1, Appeals Court (7), then Supreme Court (9)
